formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1 with reinforcing routes: SLES (2) defining plus five further prominent alkyl ether sulfates (9, 11, 12, 14, 15) -> strong by convention.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Three prominent buffers (betaine 5, glutamate 6, amphodiacetate 7) and the higher-ethoxylated Mg/oleth sulfates are a known milder blend; urea/panthenol early.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: no cationic polymer, silicone, lipid or protein; only humectants (Urea 3, Panthenol 8, Glycerin 20) and a pearlizer (10), which give little slip.

weightPotential.rationale: No deposition family at all (humectants are context; glycol distearate and Laureth-4 excluded) and strong reset -> low.

depositionLoad.rationale: No silicone, cationic, lipid, protein or film former.

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: No depositing system exists that could produce noticeable residue.
